footer.tagline: AI-powered legal assistant for SE Asia travel disputes. Built for travelers, not platforms.
footer.disclaimer: RefundRights provides general information only and does not constitute legal advice. For binding advice on your specific situation, consult a qualified lawyer in the relevant jurisdiction.

home.subtext: AI-powered legal assistant for travel disputes, flight delays, and hotel deposit issues. Built for travelers in Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia and across Southeast Asia.
home.pickCategory: Pick a category to get a tailored rights analysis and a draft complaint.
home.step1Body: Describe your situation, where it happened, and upload evidence (screenshots, receipts).
home.step2Body: Grounded in Thai CPA, Singapore CPFTA, MAVCOM rules and more — a real legal analysis, not a chatbot.
home.step3Body: A formal email, ready to send to the platform or regulator. Plus the leverage points to push back.
home.countryGuides: Country-specific guides for SE Asia travelers.

hotel.label: Hotel Issues
hotel.description: Security deposits not refunded after checkout, charges for damage you didn't cause, double bookings, or rooms that don't match what you paid for.

flight.label: Flight Disruptions
flight.description: Long delays, cancellations, missed connections caused by the airline, denied boarding, or refusal to refund a clearly airline-caused disruption.

insurance.label: Insurance Traps
insurance.description: Booking sites pressuring you to cancel an active policy, insurers denying claims using fine-print loopholes, or sellers misrepresenting coverage.
